networks.name: nanoorcloud
networks.description: Triages questions about NanoOrCloud, an app that stops developers guessing when to use on-device AI: it runs task prompts on Gemini Nano and in the cloud side by side, then recommends per-task routing (on-device / escalate / cloud) with projected monthly savings. Delegates routing questions to routing_specialist, savings and cost questions to savings_specialist, product and setup questions to product_specialist, and questions about the Open Agentic Web Challenge itself to the challenge_guide peer network, then summarizes results and guides next steps.
sample_queries: From the recorded sample run, which of the 5 preset tasks should run on-device, and why?
How much would I save per month with the sample routing, and exactly how is that number calculated?
Explain the difference between on-device, escalate, and cloud routing, with the exact thresholds.
What does NanoOrCloud need to run — browser, model, and setup — and where is the live app?

peer_policy.note: Public agent sites are reachable like web pages; credentials and capabilities do not transfer.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
